notes: Availability ARI: Jacoby Brissett starts (Carson Beck stays emergency QB, Newsweek 10-14); RB Jeremiyah Love Out (ankle), Tyler Allgeier projected lead back on a 70/30 split with Bam Knight (DK Network 10-15), Allgeier at 3.4 YPC this season; safeties Andrew Wingard and Wydett Williams Jr. Out, Budda Baker Questionable (rest, DNP Friday), Kitan Crawford Questionable while on IR; Marvin Harrison Jr. is on IR per an older ArizonaSports link, so Michael Wilson and Trey McBride carry the passing game.

Availability LA: CB Trent McDuffie Questionable (groin felt at the end of Thursday practice, sat Friday as a precaution) and S Kam Curl Questionable (ankle soreness, McVay 'feel good about him'); LT Alaric Jackson serves a one-game suspension and David Quessenberry makes his first start since 2023; Tyler Higbee and Byron Young were Friday rest days with no designation.

Kicker change not in the brief: Rams waived Harrison Mevis (5 of 9, all misses from 40+) on 10-13 and signed Blake Grupe (11 of 11 with the Colts late 2025, 75 of 94 career). The brief's LA kicker block still names Mevis; its fg numbers are stale.

Matchup: Arizona's pass defense is 31st by EPA (+0.349 per dropback allowed), allows a league-worst 32.4 points per game and 31+ in four straight; its pressure rate of 30.3% is the second-lowest in the NFL and 21.7% on third down is the league low (Rams preview). The Rams' defense is 5th by pass EPA, 3rd in pressure rate (Covers), held PHI and BUF to 2 of 19 on third down, and the team site calls it the league's best against tight ends, which matters with McBride at 28% of Arizona's targets.

Arizona's offense produced an explosive play on 32% of drives, the league low (explosive rank 32 in the brief); Brissett is at 5.31 yards per dropback over his five starts (1,110 yards on 209 dropbacks) against a league 6.23. His 243.5 feed line sits above his season average of 222.

Game script: LA -12.5, total 51.5; both offenses top-10 in pace (LA 5th, ARI 9th in seconds per play). Desk points-per-drive arithmetic lands on 51.5 (LA about 2.5 per drive against ARI's 2.64 allowed, ARI about 1.98 against LA's 1.97 allowed, 11.5 drives each), the same as the market. Rams are expected to lead by double digits, which trims Stafford's dropbacks and raises Brissett's.

Line movement: opened LA -13 / 52.5 (Covers), now -12.5 / 51.5 across books including DraftKings (-112/-108 both markets). Half-point toward Arizona and a point off the total, consistent with the Jackson suspension, McDuffie/Curl questionable tags and the kicker swap rather than sharp money on Arizona.

Current DraftKings prop board (VegasInsider, 10-17): Nacua rec yds 94.5 (o -110), Adams 56.5, McBride 63.5, Wilson 58.5, Kyren Williams rec yds 19.5, Stafford pass yds 281.5 (o -112; ScoresAndOdds shows DK under 286.5 at -112), Brissett pass yds 236.5 (o -111). The feed's Brissett 243.5 and Stafford 283.5 are 60 hours old and the Brissett number has moved 7 yards toward the under.

Situational: Rams on 6 days' rest after Monday night (short week), Cardinals on 7; no travel-zone change for Arizona (one hour, same Pacific kickoff window); McVay is 16-3 vs Arizona and 15-4 ATS; Rams scored 45 and 37 in the two 2025 meetings. Rams special teams a weakness (70-yard kick return allowed Monday, 10th kicker since Zuerlein).
